verdict.rationale: Plain-language founder guidance is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two robots.txt probes that returned HTTP 403 on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. No content about guidance, explainers or step-by-step help was retrieved, so there is no evidence the capability is delivered.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers
